module: Vehicle-side gameplay statistics relay: forwards metrics to the GE module gameplay_statistic (metricAdd/metricSet) and runs registered watch functions in turn, one per frame (scheduler). On load it enables the watchAirtime (airtime) and watchBurnout (burnout time) modules.
notes: metricAdd/metricSet send a Lua command to the GE: gameplay_statistic.metricAdd(name, value, aggregate). The name is serialized with dumps, value and aggregate with tostring.

The scheduler runs a single statSchedule function per frame, in rotation. Nothing is run if no player is seated and ai.mode is not 'disabled' (condition `not anyPlayerSeated and ai.mode ~= 'disabled'`).
onExtensionLoaded returns false (unload) if the vehicle has no wheels and uses neither hydros nor powertrain in physics step.
updateGFX is nil at rest and is enabled by addSchedule via extensions.hookUpdate.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Called on load: unloads itself for vehicles without wheels or powertrain/hydros physics, otherwise loads watchAirtime and watchBurnout and registers their workload in the scheduler.

metricAdd.desc: Adds a value to a GE metric.

aggregate.desc: Passed as is to the GE (aggregation, inferred from code).

metricSet.desc: Sets the value of a GE metric.

aggregate.desc: Passed as is to the GE.

addSchedule.desc: Adds a function to the scheduler (run once every N frames where N = number of functions) and enables updateGFX.

removeSchedule.desc: Removes a function from the scheduler; disables updateGFX if none remain.

returns.desc: true if removed, false if not found.

updateGFX.desc: Is nil at rest; when active, runs one scheduler function per frame.
